title: Matt Finucane - Now
description: This is where I am and what I'm doing right now.

content.content: I'm currently working as a platform engineer for Raisin SE in Berlin.
Refreshing my React Native knowledge by building [Boosh](https://getboosh.app), a word puzzle game and small personal project.
Exploring modern mobile development workflows, CI/CD and platform engineering practices.
Continuing to improve my German and Spanish.
Maintaining my photography website and personal projects.
Outside of technology, I enjoy cycling, hiking, photography and travelling throughout Europe.
